controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by TOI-1346; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of TOI-1346 c is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of toi-1346's light, as its colour lens measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of TOI-1346's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1346 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

TOI-1346 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (83, 84, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 219852882, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 10 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
